title: [ATen] aten/src/ATen/native/vulkan/api/QueryPool.cpp misses the inclusion of the algorithm header
bug_description:
Hi all,
due to above mentioned miss, 2.9.0-rc2 doesn't build with vulkan-backend.
In line 233 std::for_each is used, which is defined in algorithm.
So
```c++
#include <algorithm>
```
does the job.

Could you add it?

cc @malfet @seemethere
